data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'kassos', meaning pure or holy. Kassia is a name of great significance in the Christian tradition, evoking images of purity, faith, and spiritual strength. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kassia usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, holy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
